properties.name: FIELD REPORT (flo2 F10, 2026-09-19): seven more rejected calls — `id`/`decision_id`/`target_id`, `properties`/`props`, `acted_at` taken by add_requirement and refused by add_capability, add_component refusing `status` then returning `status: planned` — are the CONSTRUCTOR AND SETTER half of a defect dev_storyflow recorded on 2026-09-02, bhome corroborated on 2026-09-04 and flo2 met twice; the 2026-09-06 fix covered the relation surface only
properties.source: flo2 reflow2_feedback.md F10 (2026-09-19), root-caused the same day
properties.statement: Reporter: 'The pattern is the interesting part, and it is not my client is stale … the same concept under a different name in an adjacent tool.' MEASURED across the served surface 2026-09-19: of 20 constructors, exactly three (add_decision, add_design_rule, add_requirement) take approver/acted_at and four take status; `props` exists on create_edge and create_node only; the primary node is spelled `id` on 23 tools, `node_id` on 5, `<type>_id` on 15 and `target_id` on 4; and Component.status (with Capability, Requirement, Decision, Release, Verification and five more) still declares `default: planned` in the schema, so add_component writes a status it offers no parameter for — the exact class cap:defaults-are-not-serialized ended for Artifact.status alone on 2026-09-16 (xrt-demo). PRECEDENT: fact:defect-typed-tool-parameter-names-are-inconsistent (invalidated by the relation-surface fix) and fact:defect-sibling-constructors-disagree… (dev_storyflow, never invalidated). CAUSE: the relation half was fixed at its instance (one resolver, both naming families) and the constructor/setter half was left; the status default was undefaulted for one type and left on eleven. THE REFUSAL'S NEAREST-NAME RULE (PR #540, unmerged) was replayed on F10's seven cases before merge: two wrong by letters alone (`id`→`status`, `node_id`→`epoch_id`); rewritten to prefer node-naming fields and shared tokens, and to offer nothing for a far guess; 12 of 12 recorded cases now answer as the reporter would want.
